driver.text: Stocks rose as investors rotated out of megacap tech into small caps, the Dow and healthcare, helped by lower Treasury yields and a reversal in oil after weak September housing starts (1.221M vs about 1.3M expected).

cryptoDriver.text: Bitcoin and ether rose modestly (BTC still below $84,000). Crypto-linked stocks moved more than the tokens: Circle +5.53% and Strategy (MSTR) +4.93%. The source gives no specific catalyst for the crypto move.

items.headline: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent reported to have ordered over $35B of Nvidia chips
items.summary: Reuters report: the orders are for Nvidia's RTX Pro 5500 (Blackwell-based) workstation chips. A source told Reuters Nvidia might be able to fill only a tiny portion of the order.

items.headline: BMO Capital raises Alphabet price target to $480
items.summary: Cites recent Gemini releases, strong Google Cloud checks and growing external TPU sales; raises its Google Cloud revenue estimates 4% for 2026 and 17% for 2027.

items.headline: Broadcom and NTT DOCOMO sign 10-year agreement for DOCOMO's private cloud
items.summary: Covers licenses, technical assistance and maintenance for VMware products including VMware Cloud Foundation; the first 10-year comprehensive agreement by Broadcom Japan.
